newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore gas oil trades at new five-year high.
newsitem.headline: Singapore gas oil trades at new five-year high.

text.p: Physical gas oil traded in Singapore at a new five-year high of $31.50 per barrel on a free-on-board basis, industry sources said on Tuesday.
The sale between a European major and a Singapore trader for a 150,000-barrel cargo loading December 11-15 was 70 cents more than the previous high of $30.80 a barrel chalked up in mid November.
Gas oil prices in Singapore have risen sharply over the past few days due to renewed buying interest from China which has reduced crude runs, traders said.
China is expected to buy at an extra 100,000-tonnes for December arrival to total at least 600,000-tonnes, they said.
China normally imports between 400,000-500,000 tonnes of gas oil per month.
